name: OVT2
summary: 5-Phenoxytryptamine (5-PhO-T), also known as OVT2 or Otava 3736689, is a psychedelic drug of the tryptamine family related to 5-methoxytryptamine (5-MT; 5-MeO-T). It is the derivative of tryptamine and 5-methoxytryptamine in which there is a phenoxy group at the 5 position.

pharmacology.text: The drug acts as a biased agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor, favoring Gαi signaling over Gαq and β-arrestin1 signaling, though not favoring Gαq signaling over β-arrestin2 signaling. Its affinity (Ki) for the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor is 57.5 nM and its activational potency at this receptor ranges from 0.28 nM to 15,800 nM and efficacy ranges from 30% to 91% depending on the downstream signaling pathway.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.en: It is a research compound used to study how the 5-HT2A receptor signals. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，用於探討 5-HT2A 受體的訊號傳遞方式，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，用于探讨 5-HT2A 受体的信号传递方式，没有医疗用途。

fact.en: It is a biased agonist of the 5-HT2A receptor, meaning it tips the receptor towards one of its two internal signalling routes, a property researchers hope can separate benefit from hallucination.
fact.zh: 它是 5-HT2A 受體的偏向性促效劑，也就是把受體導向其兩條內部訊號途徑中的一條。研究者希望這種性質能把療效與幻覺分開。
fact.zhHans: 它是 5-HT2A 受体的偏向性促效剂，也就是把受体导向其两条内部信号途径中的一条。研究者希望这种性质能把疗效与幻觉分开。
